item.title: Popular python packages among R users
item.description:
I'm currently writing an R package called [rixpress](https://github.com/b-rodrigues/rixpress) which aims to set up reproducible pipelines with simple R code by using Nix as the underlying build tool. Because it uses Nix as the build tool, it is also possible to write targets that are built using Python. [Here is an example of a pipeline that mixes R and Python. ](https://github.com/b-rodrigues/rixpress_demos/tree/master/python_r)
To make sure I test most use cases, I'm looking for examples of popular Python packages among R users.
So R users, which Python packages do you use, if any?
